The tool helps in selecting the right pipe class (SDR) based on required design conditions such as temperature, required hydraulic pressure and area of application (i.e. water pipeline, sub-marine pipeline, gas pipeline).

PE pipe tool is helpful for design engineers involved in the design of pipelines for water supply, fire fighting network, recycled water network, inland/ marine pipeline and gas pipeline. As plastic pipes strength deteriorates as a temperature effect, PE pipe calculates the pipe safe working pressure after derating for temperature exposure.
